purpose: Specify how the nexus repo should consume the quantum-seeded HMAC-DRBG output produced by anima B1.
scope: Spec only. Actual nexus PRNG hook is sister-repo work (separate PR).
current_nexus_default: algorithmic urandom (cryptographically secure but classically derived)
target: Hybrid IonQ-seeded HMAC-DRBG. Quantum measurement seeds NIST SP 800-90A HMAC-DRBG; nexus PRNG draws from DRBG state.

seed_file_contract.format: JSON metadata wrapper + raw bytes hex; nexus extracts `first_output_1024_bytes_hex` field and decodes

nexus_consumer_pseudocode: # Use seed to (re-)key nexus internal HMAC-DRBG; subsequent draws are DRBG-expanded

freshness_policy.behavior_if_stale: warn but continue; falls back to algorithmic urandom only if seed file missing

refresh_shell_snippet: # refresh nexus QRNG seed via IonQ Forte 1 (run from anima repo root)
# requires: aws cli, AWS_* creds via secret get aws_braket.*
# 4. nexus pulls from latest dated dir or symlink:

hybrid_default.description: DRBG state derived from quantum seed + algorithmic urandom XOR; default mode
hybrid_default.fallback: If seed.bin missing or stale > 30d, log WARN and use algorithmic urandom only

quantum_only.description: Hard-fail if seed.bin missing or stale; no algorithmic fallback
quantum_only.use_case: high-assurance subsystems (e.g., key generation for long-lived signing keys)

classical_only.description: Disable QRNG hook entirely; revert to algorithmic urandom

honest_caveats: 1024-byte DRBG output is FINITE — once consumed nexus must reseed (algorithmic or new quantum task)
Hybrid mix means quantum entropy is the SEED only; per-sample randomness is HMAC-DRBG-expanded
No formal NIST SP 800-90B certification on this artifact; production use requires full IID/non-IID test suite over ≥1M samples
